# Dubai Approval Services

> Expert engineering and authority approval services across Dubai, UAE. We handle Dubai Municipality, DEWA, Civil Defense, Trakhees, free-zone and master-developer approvals, permits, and engineering design services. Part of the DAS and Partners Engineering Consultancy network.

## Authority & Permit Approvals

- [Dubai Municipality Approval](https://www.dubaiapprovalservices.com/dubai-municipality-approval): Building, architecture, and urban planning approvals
- [DEWA Approval](https://www.dubaiapprovalservices.com/dewa-approval): Dubai Electricity and Water Authority connections and load approvals
- [Civil Defense Approval](https://www.dubaiapprovalservices.com/civil-defense-approval): Fire safety and emergency compliance
- [Trakhees Approval](https://www.dubaiapprovalservices.com/trakhees-approval): Trakhees / PCFC approvals
- [Dubai Development Authority (DDA)](https://www.dubaiapprovalservices.com/dubai-development-authority): DDA regulatory approvals
- [TECOM & DCCA Approval](https://www.dubaiapprovalservices.com/tecom-and-dcca-approval): TECOM and Dubai Creative Clusters Authority approvals
- [DSO Approval](https://www.dubaiapprovalservices.com/dso-approval): Dubai Silicon Oasis approvals
- [JAFZA Approval](https://www.dubaiapprovalservices.com/jafza-approval): Jebel Ali Free Zone approvals
- [Dubai South Approval](https://www.dubaiapprovalservices.com/dubai-south-approval): Dubai South project approvals
- [DIEZ Approval](https://www.dubaiapprovalservices.com/diez-approval): Dubai Integrated Economic Zones approvals
- [Emaar Approval](https://www.dubaiapprovalservices.com/emaar-approval): Emaar master-developer NOCs
- [Nakheel Approval](https://www.dubaiapprovalservices.com/nakheel-approval): Nakheel master-developer NOCs
- [Concordia Approval](https://www.dubaiapprovalservices.com/concordia-approval): Concordia community approvals
- [DHA Approval](https://www.dubaiapprovalservices.com/dha-approval): Dubai Health Authority facility approvals
- [DHCC Approval](https://www.dubaiapprovalservices.com/dhcc-approval): Dubai Healthcare City approvals
- [Food Control Department Approval](https://www.dubaiapprovalservices.com/food-control-department-approval): Food business hygiene and safety approvals
- [RTA Permit and Approval](https://www.dubaiapprovalservices.com/rta-permit-and-approval): Roads and Transport Authority permits
- [SPA Approval](https://www.dubaiapprovalservices.com/spa-approval): Spa facility approvals
- [Gas Approval](https://www.dubaiapprovalservices.com/gas-approval): Gas system connection approvals
- [Solar Approval](https://www.dubaiapprovalservices.com/solar-approval): Solar PV (Shams Dubai) approvals
- [Signage Approval](https://www.dubaiapprovalservices.com/signage-approval): Signboard and signage permits
- [Swimming Pool Approval](https://www.dubaiapprovalservices.com/swimming-pool-approval): Swimming pool design and approval
- [Tent Approval](https://www.dubaiapprovalservices.com/tent-approval): Temporary tent and structure permits
- [Mezzanine Approval](https://www.dubaiapprovalservices.com/mezzanine-approval): Mezzanine floor approvals
- [Smoking Permit](https://www.dubaiapprovalservices.com/smoking-permit): Designated smoking area permits
- [Shisha Cafe License Dubai](https://www.dubaiapprovalservices.com/shisha-cafe-license-dubai): Shisha cafe licensing
- [Sand Transfer Permit](https://www.dubaiapprovalservices.com/sand-transfer-permit): Sand transfer and movement permits
- [Third Party Consultants Approval](https://www.dubaiapprovalservices.com/third-party-consultants-approval): Independent third-party inspection and approval
- [Property Snagging and Inspection](https://www.dubaiapprovalservices.com/property-snagging-and-inspection): Property snagging and handover inspection

- [Storm Water Network Design](https://www.dubaiapprovalservices.com/storm-water-network-design): Drainage network design and hydraulic studies

- [Pipeline Design](https://www.dubaiapprovalservices.com/pipeline-design): Utility and infrastructure pipeline design
- [Parking Design](https://www.dubaiapprovalservices.com/parking-design): Car park layout and circulation design
- [Building Entrance Approval](https://www.dubaiapprovalservices.com/building-entrance-approval): Building entrance and access design
- [Villa Design](https://www.dubaiapprovalservices.com/villa-design): Villa architectural, structural and MEP design
- [Building Design](https://www.dubaiapprovalservices.com/building-design): Residential and commercial building design
